A central ribbon banner contains exact offer text: 'CO HOI X2 HOA HONG' and 'VOUCHER DOC QUYEN 22%'. Instagram icons appear in the scene, including a large app icon at top right.

Surrounding elements: Shopee logo and Shopee Affiliates lockup at top left, giant headline 'UNLOCK SIEU QUYEN LOI', support line 'BAT TREND DAY REELS', central banner with exact text 'CO HOI X2 HOA HONG' and 'VOUCHER DOC QUYEN 22%', floating Instagram icons, sparkles, cash note, flowers, and partial Shopee shopping bag.
